summary.text: Bill Hancock is the Republican candidate for Tennessee House of Representatives District 59 in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces Democrat Mark Proctor for a seat with no incumbent.
Hancock advanced from the Republican primary on August 6, 2026, with 5,513 votes and no opponent on the ballot.
